pcc_validation_note: PCC against the HuggingFace reference is verified up to 512 tokens; longer lengths are capacity/liveness probes only, because a full-length torch reference for 262144 tokens does not fit in host RAM. This is a limit of the reference, not of the TTNN decoder.
forward_looking_note: Not a current limitation. At full context one layer holds 512 MiB of KV; the full 48-layer model would need ~24 GiB on a 32 GiB die, so the full-model stage (05) will have to weigh KV dtype, paging across dice, or a served-context cap. The functional decoder itself imposes no reduction.
